predictions: Had a pretty good week in the upper divisions last week (which is kind of not how thing were going in the first half of the season), but the lower divisions turned their back on me (especially F)! Posted a 16-7 record for the week, which takes me to 192-91 (67.8% correct) for the season so far. I'm up to at least six games over 0.500 in every division now, so that's a plus, but there are still a few teams that are constant confusion for me: I've gotten 3 straight Serious picks wrong to fall to 4-6 with them, and I'm 5-7 with Sanchez, and then there are The Outlaws… 3-and-friggin'-7.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Dart Knights. The story is pretty simple here: almost certainly a head-to-head battle for a top- two finish in F, and very likely a climb up to E in the fall. Seven weeks ago, the Knights just barely outlasted DT for their 3rd win in a 6-win streak. But now the Knights are actually on a 3-match slide, and in need of a long-awaited turnaround. I think they get it, barely… 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Why So Serious? Serious is in position to finally salt away the title in this crazy B race, heavily because of their huge win over Hump Day last Wednesday. This next step brings them up against a pair of the division's top guns though, so it won't be easy. Looks like Serious gets through, 14-10.

Match #3: (D Div.) Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap @ Liquor Possee. The Possee is now just three points behind Sanchez in their two-team D season marathon, and they can't really afford a down week with just two to play. But what they really can't afford would be a flippin' loss. And sadly for them, that might be what we're seeing here. Dirty, 13-11.

Matches #4 & #5: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Flight Risks; We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Flight Club. With the Risks dropping a pretty decent number on We Throw It last week, the race for 2nd (and the likely climb to F that goes with it) is alive and well here in G. Tonight, the two competitors face the toughest opponents they can - the Risks host the already-clinched-division champs, while We Throw It visits a team that dumped them last time around. Sounds like bad news for the Risks… Dartness continues their march toward a perfect season, 15-9; while We Throw It gets a little payback on Flight Club, 13-11.

Match #6: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Fringe Prime. Man, things move pretty quickly around here sometimes… Last season, I was picking matches between these two teams with a discussion of how it could determine who would finish as the league's #2 overall. But now this match is here because it might play a significant role in determining who ends up in a bottom-two spot in A (and possibly who falls to B!). Just… wow. Didn't see this coming. I'll go with Fringe, 13-11.

Match #7: (E Div.) Bottoms Up @ Cheap Shots. The Cheapies dropped 11 '01 points and a golden chance to move up last week. Now, if they want to keep any hope of hopping up into a top-two finish, they're going to have to take out E's top squad. I love the Cheapies, but the Bottoms are the bomb. Bottoms Up wins, 15-9.

Match #8: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ That's What She Said. After a 3-2 start, the Shooters have now slipped down a 7-match slide. If they want a shot at avoiding a bottom-two finish (and a fall to G?), they have to win this one, then win next week too, and get wk14 help against She Said as well. Alas, She Said ends it here, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Bully for the Element @ Talladega Flights. The A race ends tonight unless Talladega wins by 23-1 or more, so the drama level isn't high here. But this is still a matchup of the top teams in the entire league, so it's cool either way. Element, 14-10.

Match #10: (D Div.) Irish Ton @ One Dart Wonders. Super unlikely that the Irish could back in the D title fight, but this one is still very important in the Wonders' efforts to avoid a bottom-two finish (and potential fall to E in the fall). Irish take this one, 14-10.
